messages:
nina: FYI I imported the example dashboard YAML into staging and the cost/latency legend numbers are off — units mismatch on latency buckets.

lee: hmm, did you use the sample from the migration guide? I remember something about units.

nina: yes that one. buckets were written as seconds but the importer treats them as ms so p99 jumps by 1000x.

rahul: good catch. we should update the migration guide and the SDK snippet folks copy.

lee: plan: 1) change example buckets to ms, 2) add a short note in the migration guide clarifying units, 3) include a tiny before/after screenshot.

nina: I can PR the doc edits + screenshot. will add a quick validation script in the PR desc.

staging-bot: staging import created: https://staging.console.internal/imports/5332101111-preview — refresh in 5m.

docs-bot: Docs PR checklist: screenshot(s), crosslink to trace-sampling docs, run `make docs-preview` before assigning reviewers.
